findings.statement: Gross profit margin rose to 63.2% in the latest quarter from 61.5% a year earlier, and the company attributes the increase in part to pricing initiatives.
findings.rationale: The filing states the margin gain and names favorable pricing as a primary driver. Pricing is listed alongside currency, commodity cost stabilization and a divestiture, so pricing is not the sole cause and its share is not given.

quotes.text: Our gross profit margin increased to 63.2% for the three months ended October 2, 2026, compared to 61.5% for the three months ended September 26, 2025.

The increases were primarily due to the favorable impact of pricing initiatives and foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations, commodity cost stabilization, as well as the impact of the sale of our finished product operations in Nigeria.

findings.statement: The full-year picture is similar: gross profit margin increased to 61.6% in 2025 from 61.1% in 2024, mainly from favorable pricing and the refranchising of some bottling operations, partly offset by currency and higher commodity costs.
findings.rationale: A second period shows the same pattern of pricing helping gross margin, though the gain was small and mixed with a structural change (refranchising) and offsetting costs.

quotes.text: Our gross profit margin increased to 61.6% in 2025 from 61.1% in 2024. This increase was primarily due to the impact of favorable pricing initiatives and the impact of the prior year refranchising of our bottling operations in the Philippines, Bangladesh and certain territories in India, partially offset by the unfavorable impact of foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations and higher commodity costs.

findings.statement: Further down the income statement, operating margin was 33.4% in the latest quarter, below the 34.9% and 35.0% of the two prior quarters, so the gross margin gain is not visibly carrying through to operating margin.
findings.rationale: The claim is about profitability on each dollar of revenue, which operating margin captures more fully than gross margin. The sequential figures are computed by the backend and the passages do not explain the movement, so this is only a weak counterpoint.

response.rationale: The filings support the claim at the gross margin level: management ties higher gross margin to pricing initiatives in both the recent quarter and the last full year. The support is partial because currency, commodity costs and divestitures are named as co-drivers, and operating margin in the latest quarter is lower than in the two preceding quarters.
unknowns: How much of the margin gain comes from pricing versus currency, commodity costs and the Nigeria divestiture.
Why operating margin was lower in the latest quarter than in the prior two.
Whether higher prices have affected volumes.
Whether the selling, general and administrative expense trend offsets the gross margin gain.
